2607.11720.title: Active Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
2607.11720.paper_summary: Background: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables effective policies to be trained from large, previously collected datasets and subsequently improved through limited online interaction. This offline-to-online RL (O2O-RL) paradigm is particularly promising in nonstationary domains where interaction is costly or potentially hazardous. Standard O2O-RL pipelines train multiple candidate policies offline, evaluate them using off-policy or online evaluation, and then deploy and fine-tune the policy with the highest estimated value. However, as in offline pretraining, fine-tuning performance is highly sensitive to the choice of algorithm and hyperparameters, making it risky to commit to a single policy. Objectives: We study active policy selection for fine-tuning under a limited interaction budget in O2O-RL settings. To our knowledge, this is the first work to address this problem. Methods: We formulate the problem by identifying a fundamental trade-off between allocating online interactions to policy evaluation, which helps identify high-performing policies, and allocating them to fine-tuning, which improves policy performance. We then propose an approach that balances this trade-off by actively selecting policies for fine-tuning based on upper-confidence bounds on their future performance. These bounds are derived from locally linear performance forecasts fitted to observations obtained through online evaluation. Results: Across a diverse range of experiments, the proposed approach consistently outperforms existing O2O-RL baselines. Conclusions: Actively selecting and fine-tuning policies uses limited online interaction budgets more effectively than either committing to a single policy or dividing the budget equally among all policies. Our framework also advances offline RL toward practical deployment in real-world systems where online interaction is costly or risky.
2607.11720.paper_summary_zh: 背景：離線強化學習（RL）使得能夠從大量先前收集的數據集中訓練有效的策略，並通過有限的在線互動進行後續改進。這種離線到在線的強化學習（O2O-RL）範式在互動成本高或潛在危險的非穩定領域中特別有前景。標準的O2O-RL流程離線訓練多個候選策略，通過離線或在線評估進行評估，然後部署並微調估計價值最高的策略。然而，與離線預訓練一樣，微調性能對算法和超參數的選擇非常敏感，這使得承諾於單一策略變得風險很大。目標：我們研究在O2O-RL環境下，有限互動預算下的主動策略選擇以進行微調。據我們所知，這是第一個解決此問題的工作。方法：我們通過確定在線互動分配給策略評估（有助於識別高性能策略）和分配給微調（改善策略性能）之間的基本權衡來制定問題。我們然後提出一種方法，通過根據對其未來性能的上置信界主動選擇策略來平衡這一權衡。這些界限是從適合通過在線評估獲得的觀察結果的局部線性性能預測中推導出來的。結果：在多種實驗中，所提出的方法始終超越現有的O2O-RL基準。結論：主動選擇和微調策略比承諾於單一策略或在所有策略之間平均分配預算更有效地利用有限的在線互動預算。我們的框架還推進了離線RL向實際部署的發展，特別是在在線互動成本高或風險大的現實系統中。
